amanussa.p: [Na+manussa] (pu) CL=9 Amanussoti-ādīsu sadise. Nīti,sutta.37၎. Sūci,1.] the sentient beings such as deities-Brahmā who are non-human being, human-like and can assume the form of human. (a) deity. (b) Brahmā. (c) Indra. (d) demon. (e) Peta feeding human flesh, ghost, beast of prey and Rakkhasa who are named Paṃsupisācaka because they live on the ground. (f) one who maintain the being in hell.(g) Peta. (h) Vemānikapeta (the peta who possesses mansion). See original.

amānusa.p: [(1)na+mānusa.(2)na+mānasa(=mānusa+a)] (pu) CL=10 (1) A creature that is non-human but similar to a human being. (a) Deity, (b) Dragon, (c) A mystical winged human being  (Ti) (2) Not the property of human  (a) Not the sound of the humans (the sound of the terrifying waves of the Balavāmukha ocean).
